mapper.select: SELECT biz05_relate_appr_id AS relate_appr_id , biz05_promo_id AS promo_id , biz05_appr_id AS appr_id , apr01_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('AprStatusCode', apr01_status_cd, biz05_company_id, apr01_reg_date) AS status_name , NULL::varchar AS title , NULL::timestamp AS reg_date , NULL::timestamp AS effect_date , NULL::varchar AS reg_emp_name FROM biz05_relate_appr a INNER JOIN apr01_appr b ON b.apr01_appr_id = a.biz05_appr_id WHERE biz05_company_id = #{companyId} AND biz05_std_ym LIKE #{dataYm} AND biz05_link_cd = #{linkCode} AND biz05_person_id = #{personId} AND biz05_person_id IS NOT NULL
